title: Creation #1 (Genesis 1): fewer than 22 letters, no samekh, 7 days
summary: Left: the full Hebrew text of Genesis 1 in small print with blue verse numbers. Right: 'Creation #1' says Genesis 1 uses fewer than 22 letters and has no samekh (ס, shown in green three ways), and lists 7 Days; the Hebrew alphabet is laid out in three rows with samekh missing, marked by a green question mark.
